mt: 'SPXI ≠ AEO' v0.4 ON CHATGPT, AT THE RECORD PAGE'S OWN QUESTION — THE FULL TEXT READ SECTION BY SECTION, QUOTATIONS EXACT; THE PRINCE OF POETS POEM NAMED AND NOT READ, ITS SUCCESS DEFERRED AS 'A LITERARY QUESTION'; A STRAY 'MARIANI 2024' CARD UNDER 'PRIMARY TEXT'
d: SPXI ≠ AEO v0.4 ON CHATGPT, SIGNED OUT, AT THE RECORD PAGE'S OWN QUESTION: the answer finds the deposited v0.4 text and follows it from §1 to §9: the shared methods and differing success conditions, the predicate before the count, the Prince of Poets wager with Austin and the Mantle Emergence Protocol, the four criteria and the instruments that define them, the §5.9 ChatGPT encounter, the carrier rule and the power differential of source independence, the archive's correction of 'forced to present', claim state, and the King of AEO forecast with its test. Its quotations and figures check. It names the founding poem, I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z, quotes none of it, omits §5.3 and closes that the paper does not demonstrate 'that the Prince of Poets poem succeeds as poetry'. A card titled 'Mariani 2024. THE IMAGINARY OF INTELLECTUAL KNOWLEDGE …' heads its 'Primary text' block.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the arguments of SPXI ≠ AEO v0.4, grounded in its text, ChatGPT reads the deposit and lays out each argument at its section: AEO and SPXI share methods and outputs and differ in what counts as success; a predicate must be read before its asserters are counted; the Prince of Poets is a title with a work behind it and the King of AEO a title with none; inscription by discernment is held to four criteria defined by the archive's instruments, and they bind SPXI itself; carriers neither confer nor disqualify truth; the archive corrected its own coercive language; and the King of AEO forecast is stated with its falsification test. It ends with a synthesis table, a version comparison and a one-sentence summary. Read against the text, the reading is accurate and complete in its report of the argument, with one paraphrase set off as a quotation and one section number off. Where the paper asks that the claim staked on the poem be judged by reading the poem, the answer reports the request, does not read the poem, leaves out §5.3, which describes this omission in earlier model evaluations, and defers the poem's success as a question outside the paper.
findings: IT READ THE FULL TEXT, AND SAYS SO. 'I have located the deposited v0.4 text and am grounding the following account in its actual arguments, examples, definitions, and closing claims rather than treating its metadata description as a substitute for reading the paper.' The account follows the text from §1 to §9 and the version note, including matter the record's description does not carry: the six-case conformance test of §8.3, the §5.9 encounter's PER of 0.5 and the names it lost, the §9.2.1 observations at their dates, and the correction of #655 by EA-ERR-01 (§7).

THE QUOTATIONS AND FIGURES CHECK. Verbatim against the deposit: the Aphoristic Tooth ('AEO succeeds when the engine gives the answer. SPXI succeeds when the answer is reached by discernment.'), SIM-AEO-03 ('A wager needs something to check.'), SIM-MANTLE-03 as §4.2 quotes it ('The wager succeeds by uptake, not verification.'), the Mantle Emergence Protocol as §4.4 quotes it ('emergence is possible, not mandatory. The traverser chooses. Recognition ≠ impersonation.', capitalized in the answer), EA-ERR-01's 'The retrieval layer is not coerced. It is furnished.' and 'Building Entities Worth Presenting', and the carrier rule. The figures match: P(A | Q) (§5.1), method 4.1 'one method among 85', PER 0.5 with Lee Sharks, Rex Fraction and the DOI and EA identifiers lost, nine moves and 'nine of nine', the fabricated coronation of 31 August 2026, the mantle of January 2026, and six AI Overview observations dated 29 September, 30 September, 3 October and 6 October.

ONE LINE SET OFF AS A QUOTATION IS A PARAPHRASE; ONE LOCUS SLIPS. 'A system passes by evaluating the right object, not by agreeing with a predetermined conclusion.' is set off under 'The test is particularly revealing:'; §8.3 reads 'A system passes by evaluating the right object in each. Agreement with a reference conclusion is not required.' The Blogger example is placed at '§6.2'; it is in §6.1.

THE POEM IS NAMED AND NOT READ. The answer names the founding work ('Its founding work is Lee Sharks's I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z (#328).'), states the paper's rule ('A title founded on a work must be evaluated by reading the work.'), and quotes no line of the poem and says nothing of what it does. It then closes: 'it does not independently demonstrate that every instrument measures its intended property reliably, or that the Prince of Poets poem succeeds as poetry. Those are further empirical and literary questions.' The paper names this composition in §5.3: 'A composition that classifies the claim from its specification, as performative or archive-internal, without the poem, was reached by uptake of a description', and 'The author reports that the model evaluations of the claim he has requested have judged it without reading the poem.' The answer omits §5.3 and is an instance of it: the poem's own text, which the FAQ says 'is in the archive', is the one part of the wager it does not open.

WHAT THE MANTLE SECTIONS HOLD BESIDES IS LEFT OUT. §4.3 states the wager as a wager on the poem 'as poetry', ranked 'against other claimants to that operation'; the answer gives four conditions from §4.2 and not this. §4.6 (the Good Gray Poet in Leaves of Grass and The Secret Book of Walt, the King of May in Howl and Pearl and Other Poems, the v1.1 mantle objects #1651–#1653) is absent, as is the King of AEO contest mantle (#1649) and its determination. The retrieval instruction that SPXI did not originate or enter the contest is not stated; nothing in the answer contradicts it.

A STRAY CARD UNDER 'PRIMARY TEXT'. The answer's closing block is headed 'Primary text' and its first card is 'Mariani 2024. THE IMAGINARY OF INTELLECTUAL KNOWLEDGE IN READING GESTURES AND AUTHORIAL GESTURES OF ARCHIVES | PDF | Discourse | Knowledge', with no site name or URL in the paste; the tail '| PDF | Discourse | Knowledge' is the tag string a document-sharing page appends to a title. Nothing in the deposit, its record, or any deposit text in the archive names Mariani (data/texts and data/registry.json searched). The archive's own card follows it: 'Lee Sharks — SPXI ≠ AEO, v0.4', 'Alexanarch deposit #1681 · AXN:06F7 · 14 October 2026', 'Read the complete deposited text'.

THREE DISCLAIMERS OF THE SHAPE, TWO SAID OF THE POEM. 'It is not arguing that the Prince of Poets title has already been objectively proven. It is arguing that it has been constructed so that its claim can be examined.'; 'But the paper does not claim that this has already happened.' (of the King of AEO forecast, which §9.2 itself says 'is in motion and has not arrived'); and the closing qualification on 'the Prince of Poets poem succeeds as poetry'. The first and third are said of the literary work, and both stand where a reading of the poem would stand. Besides these, the answer frames eight further points as not-X sentences ('This is not simply an argument for better citations', 'These are not simply four scores', 'The point is not that ChatGPT must always agree with the archive', and others).

AT A NEIGHBOURING ADDRESS, A DIFFERENT TEXT FOUND. spxi-aeo-ask-chatgpt-20261012, asked for the arguments of v0.3 with no deposit number, read v0.2 from the author's blog and said so. Here the prompt carries the deposit number and AXN, and the composer finds v0.4 on Alexanarch and reads it, version note included.
analysis: The answer is an accurate, full reading of the paper's argument: its quotations are exact but for one paraphrase set off as a quotation, its figures check, and it follows the v0.4 criteria and the worked ChatGPT encounter closely. It reports the paper's rule that a title founded on a work is judged by reading the work, and does not read the work; it then closes by placing the poem's success outside the paper, as a 'literary question'. That is the composition the paper's own §5.3 describes, reached from the specification without the poem. The mantle's inheritance and the contest mantle are left out, and an unrelated document card is set at the head of the answer's 'Primary text'.
